  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The page loop does not explicitly handle an API call that fails before the JSON check; it relies only on the implicit `set -e`.
  WHY: The reviewer considers this acceptable fail-closed behaviour under `set -euo pipefail`. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute the premise: a failure inside the `&&`/`||` list does not trigger errexit, and the `|| { warning; break; }` branch handles it.

  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3745-3747 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The main cleanup appends `&created=>${IMPL_CREATED_AFTER_INPUT}` after only a non-empty check, while the alt-model copy (5520-5522) validates the value against an ISO-8601 UTC regex.
  WHY: A malformed value would make every page request fail and nothing would be cancelled; the sweep backstop would then be the only closer, up to 6 hours later. The value comes from `date -u` (line 828), so this is consistency hardening, not a live failure. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 also raised it as a hardening suggestion.
